claims: The Artemis II launch is scheduled for April 2026.
The Artemis II launch occurs at Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II launch is expected to be visible from parts of Florida, Georgia, and as far north as South Carolina, weather permitting.
Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex offers prime, close-up views of the Artemis II launch.
Space View Park in Titusville offers prime, close-up views of the Artemis II launch.
Jetty Park in Cape Canaveral offers prime, close-up views of the Artemis II launch.
Residents and visitors across Florida, including Orlando and as far south as West Palm Beach, should be able to see the Artemis II rocket ascend.
NASA+ is NASA's free streaming service available on website or app.
NASA's official YouTube channel provides full coverage of the Artemis II launch.
Amazon Prime Video streams the Artemis II launch.
NBC News NOW streams the Artemis II launch.
FOX Weather streams the Artemis II launch.
Artemis II launch dates and times are subject to change.
